caption: The drawing depicts a metal candle holder rendered in pencil, showing both a close-up view and a full standing view within a rectangular border. The candle holder consists of a horizontal, elongated oval platform with two cylindrical holders, each containing a candle. The central support below the platform is composed of metal—as shown by the shading and texture—and features a curving triangular brace. The holder is mounted on a tall, slender vertical rod that extends downward to a base with three outwardly curving legs. The objects are shaded to suggest a metallic surface, and the candles in the full view are white, slim, and upright. The background is plain, and the paper is off-white or light beige. The artist’s signature, “J. STALOFF,” appears in the lower left corner.
title: Candlestand
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
